mechanisms.claim: The MAST TESS definitive kernels store a state every 60 s, but only every 10th is a real orbit point. The nine between lie on the straight chord between two 10-minute nodes, so half of the 300 s fit and scoring lattice sits radially inside the orbit by GM/r^2 x 600^2 / 8: 0.94 km near perigee, 0.13 km at apogee.
mechanisms.evidence: The 60 s second differences are exactly 0 at 9 of every 10 stored states and 0.76 km at each node (scripts/raw-check.mjs, file 2026229, 2026-08-09 23:00 to 23:30). The reader keeps stored nodes as they are (files/orbit-products/src/spk_read.hpp:545). The in-arc radial residual flips between -0.46 and +0.48 km at every 5-minute point (HE|TESS|2026-08-10).

mechanisms.claim: The chord states in the fit arc cause 14 of the 19 TESS losses. FFM's state absorbs the bias and drifts along-track. AP's registered lead in the perigee windows is partly compensating error.
mechanisms.evidence: Refit both arms on the 10-minute nodes and keep the registered scoring: FFM is worse at day 1 in 2 of 7 windows instead of 6 of 7, in 5 of 28 window-leads instead of 19, and the median day-1 FFM/AP falls from 1.33 to 0.77. AP's own day-1 error rises 1.4 to 2.5 times on 08-10, 08-24 and 09-07 with clean arcs. Fixing SRP at 0.0165, or a prior of sigma 0.001 on it, leaves the loss in place (08-10, 08-24).

mechanisms.claim: The TESS truth carries velocity steps of about 1 cm/s at each apogee and perigee, so 6 of 7 of the 72 h arcs hold one and 08-31 has one 6 h after its cutoff. The premise that TESS does not maneuver fails for this truth.
mechanisms.evidence: Detected steps: 08-02 09:50, 08-09 14:00, 08-16 15:50, 08-23 23:20, 08-31 05:50, 09-06 23:30. Arcs started after a step give FFM 0.067/0.100/0.100/0.334 km (08-17; AP 0.127/0.467/1.023/8.375) and 0.087/0.152/0.145/0.260 km (08-10). On 08-31 FFM fits the node arc to 3 m and both arms leave the truth together between 06:10 and 09:10. Calling the steps momentum unloading rests on their timing only.

mechanisms.claim: Stitching the newest file at each epoch is not the cause.
mechanisms.evidence: One definitive file covering the arc and all 7 days reproduces the registered errors to within 0.11 km in all 7 windows.

mechanisms.claim: The integrator, extra third bodies, relativity and the frames are not causes. Arc conditioning is not either: longer arcs make it worse.
mechanisms.evidence: Tolerance 1e-10 with 30 s steps matches base to the meter (08-10, 09-07). Adding Venus, Jupiter and IERS 2010 relativity changes the result by 4 m or less. Shadow, tides and gravity have no effect (results/ap-gap README, HE). 168 h node arcs fit at 29 to 98 m and 336 h arcs at 0.31 to 2.11 km. The 336 h arc is worse than the 72 h node arc at day 1 in 7 of 7 windows, because longer arcs collect more steps.

mechanisms.claim: The Chandra losses are weekly joins in the merged kernel, where both arms carry the same step. Within one weekly segment the kernel is a prediction that FFM reproduces to centimeters.
mechanisms.evidence: Joins step by 2.0 to 32.8 km and up to 3.97 m/s. FFM is within 2.5e-5 km over days 1 to 3 inside one segment (HX|CHANDRA|2018-03-08). An arc started after the 04-16 join gives FFM 0.000/0.000/0.000/2.372 against AP 0.107/0.569/1.101/2.737 (HX|CHANDRA|2018-04-19).

mechanisms.claim: The THEMIS A 2013-02-13 loss is a settings defect: the regime switch keys on the radius of the first scored state.
mechanisms.evidence: all-regimes.mjs:128 (eb43ba6) chose the low-orbit settings: drag solved, SRP fixed 0.02, 40x40, arc residual 41 m. Forced to the high settings, FFM scores 0.033/0.058/0.083/0.190 against AP 0.147/0.179/0.203/0.937.

mechanisms.claim: THEMIS and Chandra show no loss of the TESS kind because their kernels hold no chord states and THEMIS is one continuous solution.
mechanisms.evidence: The collinear share is 0.000 in every HX segment, and the THEMIS joins step by 0.0000 km (out/hx-truth.json).

unsettled: Why AP is less hurt than FFM by the chord states. AP's fit internals were not examined; the measured part is that AP's perigee-window wins are partly compensating error.
What the TESS steps are. Momentum unloading is inferred from their timing and a size of about 1 cm/s; no operations log was read. The 07-27 arc's perigee step was not localized.
AP168 beats FFM168 by a wide margin on 2026-08-31 at days 2 to 7 (2.6 against 11.5 km at day 7). One window, not examined.
How accurate the TESS nodes are. Consecutive solutions differ by 0.01-0.22 km where the series switches between them, which leaves a day-1 floor of about 0.1-0.2 km for both arms.
The chord finding uses the experiment's own reader (files/orbit-products) and was not cross-checked with SPICE.
61 FFM runs were used against a cap of 60, one over because of a counting slip.
